req.title: Reject non-string title
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-003 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string. The violation was test[4] (array title) having kind=negative but heuristic=EP. The rule is that negative tests must not use EP (EP is reserved for positive equivalence partitions). Fix: change test[4] heuristic from EP to NEG, which correctly classifies it as a negative test using the NEG heuristic. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /tasks/ with JSON body {"title": "Valid Task", "description": null, "completed": false}
expected: Response JSON contains id (int), title == 'Valid Task', completed == false
trace: R-TASK-003: positive path — string title accepted; catches mutations that flip 201 to other codes or alter field values
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Valid Task", "description": None, "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Valid Task"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)

test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201()

tests.name: test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /tasks/ with JSON body {"description": null, "completed": false} (title field absent)
expected: Response JSON contains 'detail' key with at least one validation error referencing title
trace: R-TASK-003: absent title is the boundary between present-non-string and absent; BVA on field presence; catches mutations that make title optional or change required validation
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"description": None, "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)
    assert len(body["detail"]) >= 1
    locs = [str(err.get("loc", "")) for err in body["detail"]]
    assert any("title" in loc for loc in locs)

test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422()
